issue: `_FOLLOW` matches are not collected once per field and looked up by bisect, as the spec requires. `_ordered_to_follow` still calls `_FOLLOW.search(text, end, min(sentence_end, end + 200))` for each `SKILL.md` mention, and `_boundaries` returns no `_FOLLOW` match list.
